## What Is an ACT Internship?


An ACT internship is a paid, 10-week summer role at ACT, the Iowa City organization behind the ACT college admissions test. ACT calls it its Summer Internship Program and opens it to undergraduate juniors, seniors and graduate students. Interns get a mentor, hands-on projects in their field, career workshops on resumes, mock interviews and negotiation, and a showcase at the end where they present their work across ACT. Past interns quoted on ACT's page worked on research with real-world data and on content marketing. ACT doesn't publish a class size. Don't confuse it with other groups called ACT, such as Alachua Conservation Trust, Advanced Cooling Technologies or American Conservatory Theater. ACT's Iowa STEM Teacher Externships partnership is for teachers, not students.


## When Do ACT Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


ACT doesn't publish an internship calendar. Its Student Programs page describes the summer program but gives no open date, deadline or start date, and we couldn't find a dated posting for any past cycle. Its board drops roles once they close. The clearest record of recent cycles is EdTechJobs.io's list of ACT's past openings, which shows several summer 2025 internships but no dates. That leaves no basis for projecting when summer 2027 roles will post. A summer program that runs 10 weeks usually needs to hire by spring, so start checking in January and don't count on a late window.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


There's no published deadline to point to, and ACT hasn't said whether it reviews applications on a rolling basis. What we do know argues for moving fast. ACT's board is small, seven openings in total today, so an intern posting won't sit among hundreds of others, and it drops roles once they close. ACT also doesn't announce its program dates anywhere, so checking the board yourself is the only way to see a role on its first day.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


ACT lists who it's looking for on its Student Programs page, and no intern posting is live to add more detail.


• **Class year:** undergraduate juniors or seniors, or graduate students with advanced coursework completed, per ACT.


• **GPA:** not listed on ACT's current page. An October 2025 version of the same page asked for a 2.8 or higher on a 4.0 scale.


• **Work authorization and sponsorship:** not published on ACT's own pages.


• **Location:** not published for 2027. ACT is based in Iowa City, and its summer 2025 internships were marked remote in the US on EdTechJobs.io's list.


### Is the GPA a Hard Cutoff?


ACT dropped the 2.8 GPA line from its page sometime after October 2025, and it hasn't said why. Read the requirements on each summer 2027 posting when it goes live, and if a GPA floor reappears there, treat it as firm.


## What Skills Does ACT Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


ACT doesn't publish skills for its interns, and with no live posting there's nothing current to count. Its page and its summer 2025 tracks point to two kinds of work. On the research side, past interns describe research projects built on real-world data, and the PhD tracks focused on measurement and validity research. On the marketing side, one intern had a success story they wrote and designed published within the first two weeks. A finished data analysis or a published piece of writing will give you something concrete to show.

## What Is the ACT Application and Interview Process Like?


ACT doesn't publish an intern interview process. This is what its careers site shows about applying.


1. **Find the role.** Intern roles appear in the job list on Careers at ACT, which pulls from ACT's ClearCompany board. There's no separate intern application.


2. **Apply through ClearCompany.** Each posting has its own apply page on act.clearcompany.com.


3. **Interviews.** Not published on ACT's own pages.


4. **Decision.** Not published.


ACT warns applicants about recruiting scams: it only contacts candidates from @act.org addresses, and you can report anything else to careers@act.org.


### What Students on Reddit Say


We didn't find a Reddit thread from anyone who interned at ACT. Searches for ACT internships mostly return threads about the ACT test itself, so the best first-hand accounts are the intern quotes on ACT's own Student Programs page.


## How Do You Stand Out for an ACT Internship?


First, be early. ACT posts few roles and doesn't announce its intern dates, so a weekly check of its board from January 2027 matters more than anything else. Second, connect your work to ACT's mission of helping people succeed in school and at work. If you've taken the ACT or used its prep, say what you'd improve. Third, bring one finished project that fits a track: a data analysis for research, or a published article or campaign for marketing. ACT says many interns move into full-time roles but doesn't publish a class size, applicant count or conversion rate, so there's no number to benchmark against.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 ACT internship?


No. Summer 2026 has ended, and no ACT internship is open as of November 2026. ACT doesn't publish when its intern roles open or close, and we couldn't find a dated posting for a past cycle. Summer 2027 has no published date either, so start checking ACT's careers site weekly in January 2027.


### When do ACT internship applications open?


ACT doesn't publish a date. Its Student Programs page describes the summer program without an open date or deadline, and the third-party list of past openings we found has no dates. A 10-week summer program usually hires by spring, so check ACT's board weekly from January 2027.


### Are ACT internships paid?


Yes. ACT describes the summer program as competitively paid but doesn't publish a figure. EdTechJobs.io's list of ACT's past openings shows $20 an hour for summer 2025 marketing and Transformation Office internships and $23 an hour for summer 2025 PhD research internships. Check the pay on each summer 2027 posting.


### Who is eligible for an ACT internship?


ACT looks for undergraduate juniors or seniors and graduate students who've completed advanced coursework. Its current page lists no GPA, though an October 2025 version asked for 2.8 or higher. ACT doesn't publish work authorization or sponsorship rules, so read each posting when it goes live.


### Are ACT internships remote or in Iowa City?


ACT is based in Iowa City, Iowa. Its summer 2025 internships were marked remote in the US on EdTechJobs.io's list of past openings, but ACT hasn't said where summer 2027 interns will work. Check the location line on each posting, since teams may differ.


### Is this the same ACT as the test?


Yes. This guide covers ACT, the Iowa City organization behind the ACT college admissions test. Other groups share the name, including Alachua Conservation Trust, Advanced Cooling Technologies and American Conservatory Theater, and their internships are separate. ACT's Iowa STEM Teacher Externships partnership is for teachers, not students.


ACT's board is empty until summer 2027 roles post, so use the winter to build something to show. A[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives you a finished project to describe when ACT's next posting goes up.
